item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 24/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. An intense northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong later on Monday to Tuesday. There will be one or two showers over the region. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, temperatures will fall progressively over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. It will be rather cool in the morning and at night. The weather will become fine and dry. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas. With the monsoon moderating slightly, temperatures over Guangdong will rise in the latter part of this week.

Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning and at night. Bright periods during the day.
Temp range: 20 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
